title: Cloudspire
subtitle: A strategic asymmetrical tower-defense MOBA campaign across the floating sky islands of Ankar
tagline: Build your spires, deploy unique faction minions, and control the raw power of the Source.
loreSummary: High above the devastated world below float the sacred islands of Ankar. As precious Source energy leaks through the tears in reality, four deeply asymmetrical factions wage an unrelenting tactical war of fortress building, spire defense, and hero warfare.
keyFeatures: Deep solo and cooperative scenario campaigns with asymmetric objectives and dynamic AI rules
Heavy tactical integration of spire construction, minion lane routing, and hero combat
Four vastly distinct factions each boasting proprietary upgrade trees, talents, and fortress types
Premium Chip Theory Games production featuring weighted chips and neoprene battlegrounds

cloudspire_solo_coop_campaign.name: Solo & Co-op Campaign Book
cloudspire_solo_coop_campaign.description: The complete 16-scenario saga traversing all four base factions through rigorous narrative trials.

cloudspire_coop_chronicles.name: Dedicated Co-op Chronicle
cloudspire_coop_chronicles.description: The cooperative 6-scenario campaign requiring coordinated two-player tactical mastery to survive.

cloudspire_faction_mastery.name: Single Faction Mastery Arc
cloudspire_faction_mastery.description: A focused 4-scenario gauntlet mastering the bespoke mechanics and tactical nuances of one chosen faction.
